svg.aria-label: Diazotisation: primary aromatic amine → diazonium salt (0–5 °C)
svg.title: Diazotisation: primary aromatic amine → diazonium salt (0–5 °C)
svg.desc: Mechanism of diazotisation from aniline through nitrosoamine and diazohydroxide to benzenediazonium chloride
svg.text: Diazotisation: primary aromatic amine → diazonium salt (0–5 °C)
① NaNO₂ + HCl → HNO₂ + NaCl (nitrous acid is made in situ)
② HNO₂ + H⁺ → H₂NO₂⁺ → NO⁺ + H₂O (nitrosonium ion = the electrophile)
③ Ar–NH₂ + NO⁺ → Ar–NH–N=O → Ar–N=N–OH → Ar–N₂⁺ (stable only below 5 °C)
